bio: Found within the sprawling grounds of Stratford Manor is an idyllic hideaway to enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea, complete with delicious sweets and savouries and a stunning view of the countryside.  The interior is a welcoming mix of contemporary and elegant, and in sunnier climes guests are invited to eat al fresco at The Terrace Bar for the quintessential British high tea experience.  The menu includes an assortment of delicate finger sandwiches, scones with preserves and jams and a mouthwatering range of sweet treats for dessert, plus a variety of teas and coffees.  While the Manor may feel remote you'll be surprised to know that it's extremely close to the town of Stratford-Upon-Avon, which is just a five minute drive away.
